note: Bore tapped full to the set plug: the alloying powder, then the cup's own metal on top (AlSi10Mg is 10 % Si, so the Al-10Si cups keep the Si dose; the Cu-10Ni cups take more Ni to make room for the Cu). The press drives the plug to flush on a 3.2 t program under vacuum; F1 stops it there, so the dose sets the green density. The set point comes from vacuum_press.compaction(), a Heckel line through #222's E4 estimate for AlSi10Mg; Si and Ni are not calibrated, and a Si layer is harder to compact, so check the plug reaches flush on the first cups.
